subject: Request: Consortium research credits for Oxbridge Quantum Lab
messages:
From: Dr. Elena Voss <elena.voss@oxbridge.edu>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Consortium request — credits for multi-lab pilot

Hi Jordan and Monica,

I'm Elena Voss, PI for the Oxbridge Quantum Materials consortium. We're preparing a cross-lab pilot that uses LLMs to extract structured experiment metadata from legacy lab notebooks. The project is funded by an internal education & research grant (Grant ID: OX-QM-2027) and will involve six participating labs across campus.

We evaluated Redwood during a few small tests and the throughput + hosted inference latency looks promising. The research team needs an institutional trial/credit allocation so we can scale the evaluation to all labs and produce reproducible benchmarks to include in the grant report. Specifically we're hoping for: 1) a one-time promotional credit covering ~6 months of evaluation (estimate: 150k tokens/month across the consortium) and 2) continued discounted academic pricing if the pilot shows promise.

I've attached a short project proposal and a roster of participating labs. We can share a short statement on data sensitivity — all notebooks are research data; no patient-identifiable information. If procurement is required later, we're ready to engage procurement@oxbridge.edu.

Can Redwood support a credits grant for an academic consortium? Happy to jump on a quick call this week.

Thanks,
Dr. Elena Voss
Principal Investigator, Oxbridge Quantum Materials Consortium
elena.voss@oxbridge.edu
Attachment: project-proposal.pdf (PDF, 312KB)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Elena Voss <elena.voss@oxbridge.edu>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Consortium request — credits for multi-lab pilot

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary and the proposal, this is helpful. Quick questions to help with the credit evaluation:

- Confirmed participant count (6 labs) — how many distinct Redwood accounts or sub-teams will you want?
- Expected token usage per month (you mentioned ~150k); any expected burst patterns?
- Any non-public data or export restrictions beyond internal research? (helps with private deployment considerations)

If you can fill the short intake form here it will speed approvals: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/oxbridge-redwood-trial-intake (one-pager).

Internally I'll route the request to our education grants path. Monica, Rishi — tagging for credit estimate and discretionary approval.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0182
From: Dr. Elena Voss <elena.voss@oxbridge.edu>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T07:46:00Z
Subject: Re: Consortium request — credits for multi-lab pilot

Hi Jordan — thanks for the fast reply. Answers below and I've attached the consortium roster CSV.

- Participant accounts: We'll centralize under one institutional account with six named users (PI + lab leads).
- Usage: The estimate 150k tokens/month is conservative — the heavy stage will be 3 months of extraction runs followed by 3 months of analysis, so front-loaded burst possibility up to ~400k tokens/month for two months.
- Data sensitivity: All notebooks are research data about materials experiments; there is no PII or PHI. Some notebooks include instrument serials; we can redact if needed.

We can have procurement@oxbridge.edu sign any MAA or form after the trial if required.

Attached: consortium-members.csv

Happy to schedule a 30-min call with you + Monica to walk through scope.

Best,
Elena

Attachment: consortium-members.csv (CSV, 12KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T14:20:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Consortium request — credits for multi-lab pilot

Rishi — forwarding Oxbridge request. Summary: single institutional account for 6 users, expected baseline 150k tokens/month with short bursts up to 400k/month for two months. No PII/PHI. They want a 6-month promotional credit to run the pilot and ask for follow-on academic pricing.

Proposed discretionary credit: $12k total equivalent (applied as hosted credits over 6 months) — this aligns with prior academic grants for multi-lab pilots (see EDU-2026-112 precedent). If approved we'll: 1) create a dedicated promo code, 2) set up trial account and onboard with Evelyn, 3) capture contact with procurement for MAA once they convert.

If you want a shorter term or smaller amount, we can reduce to $8k (3-month heavy run + 3 months light).

Jordan — please hold on onboarding until Rishi approves.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
